earth_moon_orbital_mechanics.project_context: The Moon functions symbolically as reflection/cycle/intermediary; Earth as embodiment/world. The physical layer now gets its own orbital mechanics rather than relying on symbolic orbit language.
moon_specific: Moon's rotation period equals its sidereal orbital period: synchronous rotation/tidal locking.
Tidal dissipation transfers angular momentum and the Moon currently recedes from Earth by roughly 4 cm/year.
Observed phase cycle is illumination geometry, not a physical change in the Moon's intrinsic luminosity.

tidal_equations.equation: d_Roche ~ R_primary(2ρ_primary/ρ_satellite)^(1/3) for a simple fluid estimate

earth_moon_orbital_mechanics.timic_relevance: The real Earth-Moon system supplies precise meanings for orbit, reflection, synchronization, tidal coupling and slow secular drift. These are stronger analogies than treating orbit as generic repetition.

Saturn's north-polar hexagon is a persistent atmospheric jet/wave structure, not a solid geometric shell.

black_holes_and_accretion_disks.recovered_project_motif: black-hole transition / higher-dimensional Door / upper-disk↔central-threshold↔lower-disk imagery

equations.name: Kerr horizon radii in geometric units

disk_structure: Accretion disks are rotating plasma/gas structures outside the horizon.
Black-hole spin changes the location of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO).
Frame dragging and relativistic Doppler/gravitational effects shape observed spectra and images.
The apparent upper/lower 'disk humps' in black-hole visualizations are gravitationally lensed images of the far side of one disk, not two separate physical disks.
black_holes_and_accretion_disks.timic_relevance: Axis, rotation, threshold, irreversibility, observer-dependent accessibility and disk geometry have real GR counterparts. Black holes are not experimentally established interdimensional portals.

cmb_and_early_universe.repository_archaeology: No prior canonical Tim CMB equation was found in the repository search. CMB is therefore added as an external cosmology branch unless a primary Tim source is later recovered.
physical_story: Early matter and radiation formed a tightly coupled photon-baryon plasma.
As the universe cooled, recombination allowed photons to decouple and free-stream.
The CMB observed today is a nearly isotropic ~2.7 K blackbody with small anisotropies that encode early-universe conditions.
Acoustic peaks arise from oscillations in the pre-recombination photon-baryon plasma and depend on cosmological parameters.
cmb_and_early_universe.timic_relevance: If the project wants a rigorous early-universe 'coupling→decoupling→free propagation' model, the photon-baryon plasma and recombination provide one. This should not be confused with spiritual coupling.

subatomic_particles_and_quark_structure.project_archaeology: Earlier Timic work explicitly compared quark/nucleon relations to centers and binding across scales; August 2026 also used up/down quarks as directional analogies.
subatomic_particles_and_quark_structure.correction: Up and down are flavor names, not literal spatial directions.
standard_model: Quarks are spin-1/2 fermionic fields carrying color and electroweak quantum numbers.
Electric charges: up-type +2/3; down-type -1/3 in units of e.
hadron_composition: baryons: three-quark valence structure in ordinary QCD classification
core_physics: Asymptotic freedom: strong coupling decreases at high momentum transfer/short distance.
Confinement: isolated color-charged quarks are not observed as free low-energy particles.
Most proton/neutron mass is not simply the sum of bare up/down quark masses; QCD field and dynamical energy dominate hadron mass.

spin_and_representation_theory.repository_existing: The project already contains spinors, 2π sign change/4π restoration, chirality/helicity, Dirac operators, Berry phase and representation matrices.
theorems_and_principles: Spin-statistics theorem: under relativistic QFT assumptions, integer-spin fields are bosonic and half-integer-spin fields fermionic.
Pauli exclusion principle follows for identical fermions from antisymmetric many-fermion states.
CPT theorem: broad classes of local Lorentz-invariant quantum field theories are invariant under combined charge conjugation, parity and time reversal.
Noether theorem: continuous symmetries yield conserved currents/charges under standard variational assumptions.
spin_and_representation_theory.timic_relevance: Spin gives a mathematically exact case where apparent rotational return need not restore a spinor after 2π; representation theory reinforces the relationship-first idea that transformation law is part of physical identity.

couplings.meaning_rule: A coupling is a parameter controlling interaction strength in a defined theory. Symbolic or social 'coupling' must not be silently assigned a physical coupling constant.
couplings.timic_extension: Future Potato Dynamics should reserve 'coupling' for a typed edge with units/domain: coupling(type,source,target,strength,scale,sign,uncertainty).
